concept.title: Automatic turn off function
concept.shortdesc: If the interior lights are on, they will automatically turn off approximately 20 minutes after you turn the vehicle off and all the doors (including tailgate) are closed.

keywords.indexterm: interior lights automatic turn off function

conbody.p: If all the doors (including tailgate) are opened, the interior lights will automatically turn off after approximately 25 minutes.
If your vehicle is equipped with the theft alarm system, the interior lights automatically turn off approximately 5 seconds after the system is armed.
